      "body": "The resources route still accepts PATCH /admin/groups/:id, which previously supported changes.add and changes.delete. This update action ignores changes and sets visible to false when that parameter is absent. An existing membership-removal request therefore returns success while leaving the user in the group and changing unrelated visibility. Preserve the membership PATCH handler or explicitly reject these requests before saving."
    },

      "title": "Public group member lists are truncated without navigation",
      "body": "findMembers now requests only 50 members by default, but the public members route and template have no pagination controls or subsequent fetches. Groups with more than 50 members therefore expose only the first 50 alphabetically, with no way to view the remaining members. Add public pagination or preserve complete loading for this page."
    },
    {
      "file": "app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6",
      "line": 13,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Exact page-size multiples produce an extra empty page",
      "body": "Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 overcounts pages whenever the member count is an exact multiple of the limit. For example, a 50-member group displays 1/2 and enables Next, which requests offset 50 and displays an empty second page. Use ceiling division for the total page count."
    },
    {
      "file": "app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js",
      "line": 25,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Member reloads use the unsaved group name",
      "body": "The admin name field updates this model's name immediately, while membership additions and removals operate on the persisted group ID. If an administrator edits the name and then changes membership or pages before pressing Save, findMembers requests the unsaved name and normally receives a 404. If the draft name belongs to another group, it instead displays that group's members while subsequent mutations still target the original ID. Load members using a stable persisted identifier rather than the editable name."
    },
    {
      "file": "app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js",
      "line": 34,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Removing the last member on a page leaves an invalid offset",
      "body": "After removing a member, findMembers reloads using the old offset and cached member count, then retains the response offset even if the total has shrunk below that page. For a 51-member group, removing the sole member at offset 50 leaves an empty member list at offset 50 even though 50 members remain. When the returned total makes the requested page invalid, move to the last populated page and fetch it."
    }

findings.title: Existing membership PATCH requests now return false success
findings.body: The resources route still accepts PATCH /admin/groups/:id, which previously supported changes.add and changes.delete. This update action ignores changes and sets visible to false when that parameter is absent. An existing membership-removal request therefore returns success while leaving the user in the group and changing unrelated visibility. Preserve the membership PATCH handler or explicitly reject these requests before saving.

findings.title: Public group member lists are truncated without navigation
findings.body: findMembers now requests only 50 members by default, but the public members route and template have no pagination controls or subsequent fetches. Groups with more than 50 members therefore expose only the first 50 alphabetically, with no way to view the remaining members. Add public pagination or preserve complete loading for this page.

findings.title: Exact page-size multiples produce an extra empty page
findings.body: Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 overcounts pages whenever the member count is an exact multiple of the limit. For example, a 50-member group displays 1/2 and enables Next, which requests offset 50 and displays an empty second page. Use ceiling division for the total page count.

findings.title: Member reloads use the unsaved group name
findings.body: The admin name field updates this model's name immediately, while membership additions and removals operate on the persisted group ID. If an administrator edits the name and then changes membership or pages before pressing Save, findMembers requests the unsaved name and normally receives a 404. If the draft name belongs to another group, it instead displays that group's members while subsequent mutations still target the original ID. Load members using a stable persisted identifier rather than the editable name.

findings.title: Removing the last member on a page leaves an invalid offset
findings.body: After removing a member, findMembers reloads using the old offset and cached member count, then retains the response offset even if the total has shrunk below that page. For a 51-member group, removing the sole member at offset 50 leaves an empty member list at offset 50 even though 50 members remain. When the returned total makes the requested page invalid, move to the last populated page and fetch it.
